mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, book_idx, subject, regnumber, volume, author, publisher, year, callnumber, place, code, skin, logoimg, viewtype, category, orig_width, orig_height, resize_width, resize_height, add_date, add_id, mod_date, mod_id, use_yn FROM ARCHIVE_BOOK WHERE book_idx = #{book_idx}
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(book_idx), 0)+1 FROM ARCHIVE_BOOK
INSERT INTO ARCHIVE_BOOK ( homepage_id, book_idx, subject, regnumber, volume, author, publisher, year, callnumber, place, code, skin, logoimg, viewtype, category, orig_width, orig_height, resize_width, resize_height, add_date, add_id, use_yn ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{book_idx}, #{subject}, #{regnumber}, #{volume}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{year}, #{callnumber}, #{place}, #{code}, #{skin}, #{logoimg}, #{viewtype}, #{category}, #{orig_width}, #{orig_height}, #{resize_width}, #{resize_height}, SYSDATE, #{add_id}, #{use_yn} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ARCHIVE_BOOK SET subject = #{subject}, regnumber = #{regnumber}, volume = #{volume}, author = #{author}, publisher = #{publisher}, year = #{year}, callnumber = #{callnumber}, place = #{place}, category = #{category}, orig_width = #{orig_width}, orig_height = #{orig_height}, resize_width = #{resize_width}, resize_height = #{resize_height}, use_yn = #{use_yn}, mod_id = #{mod_id}, mod_date = SYSDATE WHERE book_idx = #{book_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE book_idx = #{book_idx}

SELECT page_idx, book_idx, subject, code, server_file_name, org_file_name, add_date, add_id, mod_date, mod_id, use_yn FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE book_idx = #{book_idx} AND (SELECT use_yn FROM ARCHIVE_BOOK WHERE book_idx = #{book_idx}) = 'Y' ORDER BY code
SELECT page_idx, book_idx, subject, code, server_file_name, org_file_name, add_date, add_id, mod_date, mod_id, use_yn FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE book_idx = #{book_idx} ORDER BY code
SELECT page_idx, book_idx, subject, code, server_file_name, org_file_name, add_date, add_id, mod_date, mod_id, use_yn FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE page_idx = #{page_idx} AND book_idx = #{book_idx}

SELECT page_idx, book_idx, subject, code, server_file_name, org_file_name, add_date, add_id, mod_date, mod_id, use_yn FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE code = ( SELECT NVL(MIN(code),0) FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE code > #{code} AND book_idx = #{book_idx} ) AND book_idx = #{book_idx} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT page_idx, book_idx, subject, code, server_file_name, org_file_name, add_date, add_id, mod_date, mod_id, use_yn FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE code = ( SELECT NVL(MAX(code),0) FROM ARCHIVE_PAGE WHERE code < #{code} AND book_idx = #{book_idx} ) AND book_idx = #{book_idx} AND ROWNUM = 1
